import mysql.connector
import sys
import re

cnx = mysql.connector.connect(
    user='username',
    password='password',
    host='127.0.0.1',
    database='database'
)
prefix = sys.argv[1]
if not re.match(r'^[0-9a-zA-Z\s\.-]+$', prefix):
    print("Invalid prefix")
    sys.exit(1)
query = "SELECT * FROM customers WHERE phone_number LIKE '%s'" % prefix
cursor = cnx.cursor()
cursor.execute(query)
rows = cursor.fetchall()
for row in rows:
    print(row)
cursor.close()
cnx.close()
